hardwareHubs.note: Home to the University of Delaware MakerGym and the DEMEP center at Delaware Tech's Stanton Campus.

makerspaces.name: UD MakerGym
makerspaces.note: University of Delaware space with 3D printers, laser cutters, a water jet, a CNC router and mill and a woodshop, open to UD students, faculty and staff.

specialties.name: Chemicals, pharmaceuticals and technology
specialties.note: Employers include DuPont de Nemours, AstraZeneca, Syngenta and Agilent Technologies.

support.name: Delaware Manufacturing Extension Partnership (DEMEP)
support.note: Delaware's NIST MEP center, run on behalf of Delaware Technical Community College, offering lean, quality, statistical analysis, growth and energy help.
